'''FK Metta''' (also  called '''FS Metta/Latvijas Universitāte''' from 2007 to 2018) is a professional [[Latvia]]n [[football (soccer)|football]] club based in [[Riga]]. As of 2012 they play in the [[Latvian Higher League]]. Metta plays its home games at [[Daugava Stadium (Riga)|Daugava Stadium]]. Until June 2018, their home venue was the Riga Hanza Secondary School Stadium."}}
